instruction: Cinematic video still, medium shot from a slightly low angle. In an indoor studio with a plain backdrop, two women dance together under soft blue and pink gradient lighting. On the left, the blonde woman in the black halter dress (R3) smiles warmly with her hands resting on her head, looking towards her friend. On the right, the woman with dreadlocks in the red fringed dress (R1) dances energetically with her hands raised, looking down with a happy expression.
elements: R1 dances energetically with her hands raised while looking down
R3 smiles warmly with her hands resting on her head while looking toward R1
R1 and R3 have distinct dance poses rather than mirrored roles
R3's role is the hands-on-head smiling pose directed toward her friend
